runs.t: This document replaces Chapter 7 of Todd Lammle, CCNA Certification Study Guide, Volume 2, Exam 200-301 (2020), book pages 193 to 218 (PDF pages 251 to 276). It follows the book's order, keeps its learning objectives, and adds plain-English explanations, command breakdowns, labs and questions. Every difference from the book is tagged.

The book's hardware (2960, 3560, 3850, console on the back, PoE button on the front) is dated; current Catalyst 9000 switches run IOS XE. The commands in this chapter are the same.

Link lights go amber, then green while spanning tree converges. The book says this takes about
. For a newly connected port with classic STP it is typically

On which interface do you put the management IP of a Layer 2 switch?
A VLAN interface (SVI), usually interface vlan 1 - Not on a physical port.
You set an IP on interface vlan 1 and the interface shows administratively down. Why?
The SVI is shut down by default; type no shutdown - A very common mistake.
Why did the first ping lose one packet?
ARP had to resolve the MAC address first - The later pings work.
Is a default gateway needed on a switch?
Only to manage it from another subnet - Switching itself does not need it.

These 22 questions are original. Also do the book's own 10 review questions (pages 216 to 218) and check them in the book's Appendix.
A switch receives a frame whose destination MAC is in the table on port Fa0/4. The frame came in on Fa0/2. What happens?
It is forwarded only out Fa0/4 - Known destination means filtering (script checked).
Same switch, but the destination is not in the table. What happens?
Flooded out all ports except Fa0/2 - The source is also learned on Fa0/2.
Which address does a switch learn from?
A - A Layer 2 switch ignores IP.
How many collision and broadcast domains does an 8-port switch with default settings have?
8 collision domains, 1 broadcast domain - Every port is its own collision domain; no VLANs yet.
What is the default MAC aging time?
300 seconds - Secondary source; check on your device.
Which three functions does a Layer 2 switch perform?
Address learning, forward/filter decisions, loop avoidance - The book's three functions.
Which problem is NOT caused by switching loops?
D - Duplicate IPs come from addressing mistakes.
Which command shows the MAC address table?
show mac address-table - Older IOS uses show mac-address-table.
What are the defaults after you enable port security on a port?
Maximum 1 MAC, violation shutdown - Port security itself is off until enabled.
Which mode does not shut the port and sends no log or SNMP trap?
A - Restrict logs and traps; shutdown also disables the port.
on a port still in default dynamic mode. What do you expect?
The command is rejected; make it an access port first - Port security is not allowed on dynamic ports.
Which command makes learned MACs stick to the configuration?
switchport port-security mac-address sticky - They go in the running-config; save to keep them.
Maximum is 3, sticky is on, four different PCs connect in turn. What happens to the fourth?
A violation; with the default mode the port goes err-disabled - Three MACs fill the limit.
How do you recover an err-disabled secure port by hand?
shutdown, then no shutdown - After fixing the cause.
Is this a valid MAC for IOS: aa.bb.cc.dd.ee.ff?
No. Use aabb.ccdd.eeff - Format check by script.
Where do you configure the management IP address on a Layer 2 switch?
On an SVI, for example interface vlan 1 - Not on a physical port.
You set an SVI IP address but cannot ping it. The interface is administratively down. Fix?
no shutdown on the SVI - SVI is shut down by default.
Management subnet 192.168.10.16/28. What are the usable host range and a valid gateway at the top of the range?
Why is Telnet a poor choice for managing a switch?
It sends passwords in clear text; use SSH - Update to the book.
A built-in multicast MAC for Cisco protocols like CDP, handled by the CPU - Not the switch base MAC.
A port shows many learned MACs. What is likely behind it?
Another switch, a hub or an access point - Many hosts share one port.
